user.title: Add a zone
user.description: Pick what you're watering and how it should decide. The next step only asks for what that choice needs.

data_description.plant_type: Sets sensible defaults for this kind of plant.
data_description.mode: Soil sensor waters when the ground is dry. Weather estimate works it out from the forecast. Both uses either.
data_description.dosing_type: Volume for drip/emitters (litres). Depth for sprinklers (mm over an area).

settings.title: Zone settings
settings.description: Defaults come from the plant type — for most people they're all you need.

data_description.soil_sensor: A moisture sensor in this zone (%).
data_description.moisture_low: Water when the reading drops to this.
data_description.liters_per_plant: A deep soak for one plant, e.g. ~10 L for a hedge shrub.
data_description.plant_count: How many plants this drip line feeds.
data_description.flow_lpm: Combined output of this zone's emitters or nozzles.
data_description.rain_sensor: Optional. Skip watering after rain, e.g. a 7-day rainfall total.
data_description.min_interval_days: Never water more often than this.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: Fine-tuning. The plant-type defaults are usually fine.

data_description.et_source: Automatic uses Open-Meteo for your Home Assistant location — no sensor needed.
data_description.et0_sensor: Only used when the ET₀ source is set to sensor.
data_description.crop_coefficient: How thirsty this plant is vs. a reference lawn.
data_description.et_trigger_mm: Water once the estimated water deficit reaches this.
data_description.rain_effectiveness: Percentage of rain that actually soaks in to this zone. Lower it for mulched, deep-rooted or drip zones, where rain mostly wets the surface.
data_description.rain_interception_mm: Each day, this much rain is lost to surface evaporation before the rest counts — so light showers don't cancel a watering.
data_description.rain_skip_mm: Skip watering when the rainfall sensor reads at least this. The window — e.g. the last 7 days — is whatever that sensor measures.

init.title: Zone
init.description: Change what you're watering or how it decides; the next step has the matching settings.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: Fine-tuning. The plant-type defaults are usually fine.
